summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin People Tab, Export CSV, PWA, and Leave a Review features. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend People tab works correctly with unified list of loyalty members, contacts, and check-ins. Export CSV downloads properly. PWA manifest and service worker are accessible. Leave a Review button uses location-specific Google Review URLs.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking People tab directly from Dashboard sometimes doesn't render content immediately - requires clicking another tab first then People tab
ui_bugs.workaround: Click another tab first, then click People tab

seed_data_creation: Created test loyalty member and contacts during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: People Tab feature fully tested. Export CSV works correctly. PWA manifest and service worker accessible. Leave a Review button uses location-specific Google Review URLs from mockData.js.
